COLDWAR_KOR_send_red_cross_channel = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_send_red_cross_channel = yes }
		KOR = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_sender_party = ruling_party }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_sender_office_epoch = COLDWAR_KOR_office_epoch }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_assent_KOR
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_assent_NKO
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_pending
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_offer_open days = 60 }
		}
		NKO = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_assent_NKO
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_pending
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_offer_open days = 60 }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.1 }
		}
		KOR = {
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.201 days = 61 }
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_accept_red_cross_channel = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_accept_red_cross_channel = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tag = NKO }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_assent_NKO
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NKO = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_assent_NKO }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_assent_KOR
			}
			NKO = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_assent_NKO
			}
			KOR = {  }
			NKO = {  }
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }
			KOR = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.101 }
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_refuse_red_cross_channel = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_refuse_red_cross_channel = yes }
		KOR = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_offer_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_assent_KOR
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_refused
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_cooldown days = 180 }
		}
		KOR = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_assent_NKO

}
COLDWAR_KOR_expire_red_cross_channel = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_offer_open }
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_pending
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_offer_open
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_expired
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_cooldown days = 180 }
		KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_assent_KOR }
		KOR = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_assent_NKO
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_target_NKO
		}
		NKO = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_offer_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_assent_NKO
		}
	}
}

		KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_parallel_recognition_assent_KOR }
		KOR = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_parallel_recognition_assent_NKO
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_parallel_recognition_target_NKO
		}
		NKO = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_parallel_recognition_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_parallel_recognition_offer_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_parallel_recognition_assent_NKO
		}
	}

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_pending
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_offer_open days = 60 }

COLDWAR_KOR_accept_limited_trade = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_accept_limited_trade = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tag = NKO }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_assent_NKO
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NKO = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_assent_NKO }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_assent_KOR
			}
			NKO = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_assent_NKO
			}
			KOR = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			NKO = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_limited_trade_kor }
			}
			NKO = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_limited_trade_partner }
			}
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }
			KOR = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.110 }
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_refuse_limited_trade = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_refuse_limited_trade = yes }

			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_offer_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_assent_KOR
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_refused
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_cooldown days = 180 }
		}
		KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_assent_NKO clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_target_NKO }
		NKO = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_offer_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_assent_NKO
		}
		KOR = {
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.110 }
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_expire_limited_trade = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_offer_open }
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_pending
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_offer_open
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_expired
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_cooldown days = 180 }
		KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_assent_KOR }
		KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_assent_NKO clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_target_NKO }
		NKO = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_offer_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_limited_trade_assent_NKO
		}
	}
}

			NOT = {
				JAP = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_JAP_signed }
			}
		}
		KOR = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_sender_party = ruling_party }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_sender_office_epoch = COLDWAR_KOR_office_epoch }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_JAP
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_pending
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_offer_open days = 60 }

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_JAP
		}
		JAP = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_JAP
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_pending
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_offer_open days = 60 }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.13 }
		}

COLDWAR_KOR_send_technology_licence_to_USA = {

		limit = {
			COLDWAR_KOR_can_send_technology_licence = yes
			NOT = {

			}

			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_USA
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_pending
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_offer_open days = 60 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_target_USA
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_USA
		}
		USA = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_USA
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_pending
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_offer_open days = 60 }

		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_accept_technology_licence = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_accept_technology_licence = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tag = JAP }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_JAP
		}
		if = {
			limit = { tag = USA }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_USA
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = JAP
				KOR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_target_JAP
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_JAP
				}
			}
			KOR = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_JAP_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_target_JAP
			}
			KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_JAP }
			JAP = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_JAP_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_JAP
			}
			KOR = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_signed days = 1095 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_JAP_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			JAP = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_signed days = 1095 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_JAP_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_technology_licence_kor }
			}
			JAP = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }
			KOR = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.113 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = USA
				KOR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_target_USA
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_USA
				}
			}
			KOR = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_USA_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_target_USA
			}
			KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_USA }
			USA = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_USA_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_assent_USA
			}
			KOR = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_signed days = 1095 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_USA_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			USA = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_signed days = 1095 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_technology_licence_USA_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_technology_licence_kor }
			}
			USA = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }
			KOR = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.113 }
			}
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_accept_allied_procurement_contract = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tag = USA }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_assent_USA
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_assent_USA }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_assent_KOR
			}
			USA = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_assent_USA
			}
			KOR = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			USA = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_allied_procurement_contract_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_allied_procurement_contract_kor }
			}
			USA = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 2 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }
			KOR = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.114 }
			}
		}
	}

COLDWAR_KOR_accept_security_partner_contacts = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_accept_security_partner_contacts = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tag = JAP }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_assent_JAP
		}
		if = {
			limit = { tag = USA }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_assent_USA
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = JAP
				KOR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_target_JAP
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_assent_JAP
				}
			}
			KOR = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_JAP_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_target_JAP
			}
			KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_assent_JAP }
			JAP = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_JAP_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_assent_JAP
			}
			KOR = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_signed days = 1095 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_JAP_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			JAP = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_signed days = 1095 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_JAP_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_security_partner_contacts_kor }
			}
			JAP = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }
			KOR = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.116 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = USA
				KOR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_target_USA
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_assent_USA
				}
			}
			KOR = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_USA_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_target_USA
			}
			KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_assent_USA }
			USA = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_USA_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_assent_USA
			}
			KOR = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_signed days = 1095 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_USA_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			USA = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_signed days = 1095 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_security_partner_contacts_USA_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_security_partner_contacts_kor }
			}
			USA = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }
			KOR = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.116 }
			}
		}
	}
}

			}

				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_japan_technology_finance_signed

				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_japan_technology_finance_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_japan_technology_finance_assent_KOR
			}
			JAP = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_japan_technology_finance_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_japan_technology_finance_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_japan_technology_finance_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_japan_technology_finance_assent_JAP
			}
			KOR = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_japan_technology_finance_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_japan_technology_finance_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			JAP = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_japan_technology_finance_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_japan_technology_finance_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_japan_technology_finance_kor }
			}
			JAP = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 2 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }
			KOR = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.117 }
			}
		}
	}

COLDWAR_KOR_accept_alternative_finance_contacts = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_accept_alternative_finance_contacts = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tag = USA }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_assent_USA
		}
		if = {
			limit = { tag = GER }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_assent_GER
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = USA
				KOR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_target_USA
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_assent_USA
				}
			}
			KOR = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_USA_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_target_USA
			}
			KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_assent_USA }
			USA = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_USA_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_assent_USA
			}
			KOR = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_signed days = 1095 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_USA_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			USA = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_signed days = 1095 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_USA_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_alternative_finance_contacts_kor }
			}
			USA = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }
			KOR = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.119 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = GER
				KOR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_target_GER
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_assent_GER
				}
			}
			KOR = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_GER_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_target_GER
			}
			KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_assent_GER }
			GER = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_GER_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_assent_GER
			}
			KOR = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_signed days = 1095 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_GER_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			GER = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_signed days = 1095 }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_alternative_finance_contacts_GER_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_alternative_finance_contacts_kor }
			}
			GER = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }
			KOR = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.119 }
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_KOR_send_nordpolitik_recognition_to_SOV = {

			COLDWAR_KOR_can_send_nordpolitik_recognition = yes

				SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_SOV_signed }

			set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_sender_party = ruling_party }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_sender_office_epoch = COLDWAR_KOR_office_epoch }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_assent_SOV
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_pending
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_offer_open days = 60 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_target_SOV
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_assent_SOV
		}
		SOV = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_assent_SOV
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_pending
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_offer_open days = 60 }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.20 }
		}
		KOR = {
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.220 days = 61 }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_KOR_accept_nordpolitik_recognition = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_accept_nordpolitik_recognition = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tag = SOV }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_assent_SOV
		}
		if = {
			limit = { tag = CHI }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_assent_CHI
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = SOV
				KOR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_target_SOV
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_assent_SOV
				}
			}
			KOR = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_SOV_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_target_SOV
			}
			KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_assent_SOV }
			SOV = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_SOV_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_assent_SOV
			}
			KOR = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_SOV_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_SOV_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			SOV = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_signed days = 1095 }
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_SOV_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_SOV_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			KOR = {
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_nordpolitik_recognition_kor_sov }
			}
			SOV = {
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_nordpolitik_recognition_partner_sov }
			}
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }
			KOR = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.120 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = CHI
				KOR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_target_CHI
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_assent_CHI
				}
			}
			KOR = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_CHI_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_target_CHI
			}
			KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_assent_CHI }
			CHI = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_CHI_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_assent_CHI
			}
			KOR = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_CHI_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_CHI_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			CHI = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_signed days = 1095 }
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_CHI_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nordpolitik_recognition_CHI_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			KOR = {
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_nordpolitik_recognition_kor_chi }
			}
			CHI = {
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_nordpolitik_recognition_partner_chi }
			}
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }

			}

COLDWAR_KOR_accept_revolutionary_recognition = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_accept_revolutionary_recognition = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tag = SOV }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_assent_SOV
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_assent_SOV }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_assent_KOR
			}
			SOV = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_assent_SOV
			}
			KOR = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			SOV = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_signed
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_signed days = 1095 }
			}
			KOR = {
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_revolutionary_recognition_kor }
			}
			SOV = {
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_revolutionary_recognition_partner }
			}
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }
			KOR = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.122 }
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_KOR_expire_revolutionary_recognition = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_offer_open }
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_pending
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_offer_open
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_expired
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_cooldown days = 180 }
		KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_assent_KOR }
		KOR = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_assent_SOV
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_target_SOV
		}
		SOV = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_offer_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_revolutionary_recognition_assent_SOV
		}
	}
}

		}

			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_vietnam_withdrawal_settlement_offer_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_vietnam_withdrawal_settlement_assent_USA

			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_vietnam_withdrawal_settlement_target_USA
		}

COLDWAR_KOR_send_korean_community_dialogue = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_send_korean_community_dialogue = yes }
		KOR = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_sender_party = ruling_party }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_sender_office_epoch = COLDWAR_KOR_office_epoch }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_assent_KOR
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_assent_NKO
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_pending
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_offer_open days = 60 }
		}
		NKO = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_assent_NKO
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_pending
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_offer_open days = 60 }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.29 }
		}
		KOR = {
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.229 days = 61 }
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_accept_korean_community_dialogue = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_accept_korean_community_dialogue = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tag = NKO }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_assent_NKO
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NKO = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_assent_NKO }
			}
			KOR = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_assent_KOR
			}
			NKO = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_signed
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_offer_open
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_assent_NKO
			}
			KOR = {  }
			NKO = {  }
			KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes }
			KOR = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.129 }
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_refuse_korean_community_dialogue = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_can_refuse_korean_community_dialogue = yes }
		KOR = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_offer_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_assent_KOR
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_refused
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_cooldown days = 180 }
		}
		KOR = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_assent_NKO
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_target_NKO
		}
		NKO = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_offer_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_assent_NKO
		}
		KOR = {
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_foreign.129 }
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_expire_korean_community_dialogue = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_offer_open }
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_pending
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_offer_open
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_expired
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_cooldown days = 180 }
		KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_assent_KOR }
		KOR = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_assent_NKO
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_target_NKO
		}
		NKO = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_offer_open
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_korean_community_dialogue_assent_NKO
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_KOR_contract_maintenance = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			KOR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_pending
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_offer_open }
			}
		}
		KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_expire_red_cross_channel = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			KOR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_signed }
			OR = {
				KOR = { exists = no }
				KOR = { is_subject = yes }
				NKO = { exists = no }
				NKO = { is_subject = yes }
				NKO = { has_war_with = KOR }
			}
		}
		KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_signed }
		NKO = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_red_cross_channel_signed }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			KOR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_family_reunions_pending
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_family_reunions_offer_open }
			}
		}
		KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_expire_family_reunions = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			KOR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_family_reunions_signed }
			OR = {
				KOR = { exists = no }
				KOR = { is_subject = yes }
				NKO = { exists = no }
				NKO = { is_subject = yes }
				NKO = { has_war_with = KOR }
			}
		}
		KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_family_reunions_signed }
		NKO = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_family_reunions_signed }
		KOR = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_family_reunions_kor }
		}
		NKO = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_family_reunions_partner }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			KOR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_family_reunions_signed }
			NOT = {
				NKO = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_family_reunions_signed }
			}
		}
		KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_family_reunions_signed }
		NKO = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_family_reunions_signed }
		KOR = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_family_reunions_kor }
		}
		NKO = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_family_reunions_partner }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			KOR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_military_hotline_pending
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_military_hotline_offer_open }
			}
		}
		KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_expire_military_hotline = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			KOR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_military_hotline_signed }
			OR = {
				KOR = { exists = no }
				KOR = { is_subject = yes }
				NKO = { exists = no }
				NKO = { is_subject = yes }
				NKO = { has_war_with = KOR }
			}
		}
		KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_military_hotline_signed }
		NKO = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_military_hotline_signed }
		KOR = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_military_hotline_kor }
		}
		NKO = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_military_hotline_partner }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			KOR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_military_hotline_signed }
			NOT = {
				NKO = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_military_hotline_signed }
			}
		}
		KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_military_hotline_signed }
		NKO = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_military_hotline_signed }
		KOR = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_military_hotline_kor }
		}
		NKO = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_military_hotline_partner }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			KOR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nonaggression_compact_pending
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nonaggression_compact_offer_open }
			}
		}
		KOR = { COLDWAR_KOR_expire_nonaggression_compact = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			KOR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nonaggression_compact_signed }
			OR = {
				KOR = { exists = no }
				KOR = { is_subject = yes }
				NKO = { exists = no }
				NKO = { is_subject = yes }
				NKO = { has_war_with = KOR }
			}
		}
		KOR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nonaggression_compact_signed }
		NKO = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_nonaggression_compact_signed }
	}
	if = {

COLDWAR_KOR_grandfather_nko_framework = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NKO = { exists = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NKO_korean_channel_accepted }
			KOR = { exists = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NKO_korean_channel_accepted }
		}
		KOR = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_working_contacts_signed }
		NKO = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_working_contacts_signed }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NKO = { exists = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NKO_korean_channel_confederation_offer_accepted }
			KOR = { exists = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NKO_korean_channel_confederation_offer_accepted }
		}
		KOR = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_KOR_confederal_member set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_sovereign_confederation_signed }
		NKO = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_KOR_confederal_member set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_sovereign_confederation_signed }
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			KOR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_family_reunions_signed is_subject = no }
			NKO = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_family_reunions_signed
				is_subject = no
				NOT = { has_war_with = KOR }
			}
			KOR = {

				}
			}
		}
		KOR = {
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_1970_foreign_family_reunions_kor }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {

					is_subject = no

				}

		}

		limit = {

			NKO = {

				NOT = { has_war_with = KOR }
			}

				}
			}
		}

		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				KOR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_family_reunions_signed is_subject = no }
				NKO = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_family_reunions_signed
